title: Warra Dhugaa Barbaadan Hirriba
intro: Mee yeroo amantiin mormii keessa ture, gareen lubbuu tokko jajjabina biyya lafaa irra amantii hin sochoone filate yaadi. Filannoon sodaachisaa isaan mudatee, imala hirriba adda taʼe isaan mudatu jalqaban. Seenaan isaanii eegumsa waaqummaa fi humna amantii cunqursaa irratti qabuuf ragaadha. Eenyummaa namoota dinqisiisoo kanaa adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Walgaʼii xinnoo, Uumaa Tokkichatti amantii gadi fagoo qabnuun walitti qabamne turre.
Bara bulchaan humna guddaa qabu Rabbiin ala ibaadaa gaafatu keessa jiraanne.
Amantii keenya eeguuf mana keenya dhiisnee cunqursaa jalaa baqachuuf murteessine.
Hiriyaan amanamaan, uumama lafaa, imala keenya irratti nu waliin ture.
Iddoo dhokataa ta’etti, bakka Rabbiin hirriba gadi fagoo fi dheeraa ta’e akka seennu nu godhetti bakka qulqulluu arganne.
Yeroo dammaqnu guyyaa tokko ykn kutaan guyyaa qofti akka darbe amanne, garuu jaarraawwan dhuguma darbaniiru.
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
